title: Preparation of s/o/w Emulsion Using SPG Membrane
author: Daisuke Yasui
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6edhba6

steps.title: Prepare Aqueous Phase Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a solution of half-saline and Polyoxyethylene hydrogenated castor oil 60 (HCO 60).

substeps.instruction: Add 0.08 mg of Polyoxyethylene hydrogenated castor oil 60 (HCO 60).
Mix the solution using a stirrer.

steps.title: Prepare Filter Kit
steps.instruction: Load the aqueous solution into the SPG membrane filter kit.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the solution into a 10 mL syringe.
Connect the syringe to a filter kit containing a 20 μm hydrophilic-coated SPG membrane (SPG Technology Co., Ltd).
Push the entire solution into the filter kit.

steps.title: Prepare Miriplatin Suspension
steps.instruction: Create a miriplatin suspension using Lipiodol.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 3 mL of Lipiodol (Gurbet, Villepinte, France) into a syringe.
Add the Lipiodol to the bottle of miriplatin (Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma, Osaka, Japan) to prepare the suspension.

steps.title: Set Up Emulsion Process
steps.instruction: Connect the miriplatin suspension to the filter kit and initiate the pump and stirrer.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the miriplatin suspension with a syringe and connect it to the previously prepared filter kit.
Aspirate air out of the system.
Attach the syringe to a syringe pump.
Position a stirrer beneath the filter kit.
Start the syringe pump at a speed of 20 mL/hr and simultaneously start the stirrer at a speed of 300 rpm.

steps.title: Adjust Stirring Speed
steps.instruction: Gradually increase the stirrer speed over time.

substeps.instruction: Increase the stirrer speed by 200 rpm every 5 minutes.
